Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Trial evaluation: prompt submission playbook & success criteria (Clovity)

Hi Liam / Priya —

Great session today — thanks for walking us through the Clovity use cases and the sample logs. This thread captures the agreed next steps for the trial evaluation and the prompt/ logs handoff so we can start building the eval set. Please see the two short asks below and the success criteria we discussed.

Quick recap (from today's discovery):
- Primary goal: measure precision/recall and hallucination rates for the customer-facing "task-summarizer" flows across 3 example intents.
- Expected volume during trial: ~6k prompts + historical logs (~30k tokens/day peak).
- Data sensitivity: PII present in free-texts; will need redaction guidance.

Success criteria (POC):
1) Coverage: test set covers top-3 intents and includes 200 labeled golden prompts per intent.
2) Latency: 95th percentile generation under 400ms in Redwood Dedicated baseline.
3) Quality: automated metrics (BLEU/ROUGE-like + hallucination flag) + at least one manual eval pass with >85% acceptable responses.
4) No PII leakage: redaction validated on sample set prior to ingest.

Immediate asks (what we need from you):
1) Small sample artifact by Apr 6: 100 representative prompts (CSV) + 10 full raw logs (redacted or masked) so Rafael can draft the evaluation rubric. Please use the attached prompt_ingest_template_v1.csv as the CSV schema.
2) Bulk export method & timeline by Apr 13: SFTP or shared drive works — Marcus will coordinate transfer.

Attachments: prompt_ingest_template_v1.csv (template CSV with columns: prompt_id, intent, user_text, context, timestamp, redaction_flags)

Owners on our side:
- Marcus Lin — ingestion + SFTP setup (marcus_lin@redwood.ai)
- Rafael Mendes — eval design + metrics (rafael_mendes@redwood.ai)
- Laura Bennett — security & redaction checklist (laura_bennett@redwood.ai)

Next steps / timeline:
- Apr 6: sample prompts + example logs (you)
- Apr 7–13: Rafael drafts eval rubric; Marcus configures ingest path
- Apr 14: first ingest + dry-run of sample prompts
- Apr 21: initial evaluation metrics report

If that looks right, please reply with the sample CSV and preferred transfer method. Happy to hop on a 15-min sync if helpful.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai]

Attaching sample now.
